purpose: Adaptive calibration only. Reuses the first 60 seeds of bank 2; not independent validation and not a promotion bank. All attempted candidates are retained.

inputs.name: Harvest road
inputs.one: The gate is open and defenders have four Shakti; the raiders have 20 rounds.

inputs.name: Quiet gate
inputs.one: The gate is open and raiders start without Shakti, with 18 rounds to take the fort.

inputs.name: Brass reserve
inputs.one: The defenders replace their Maharathi with a second Divyadrishti.

inputs.name: Two clear sights
inputs.one: A second Divyadrishti replaces your Ashvarohi; your raiders begin with three Shakti.

inputs.name: Silver watch
inputs.one: Night opens the battle; your raiders begin with four Shakti.

inputs.name: Shishir stillness
inputs.one: The rings turn every six rounds; your raiders begin with three Shakti.

inputs.name: Vasant advance
inputs.one: The raiders have 28 rounds to find a way through.

inputs.name: Archer watch
inputs.one: A second Dhanurdhar replaces the defenders’ Ashvarohi; your raiders begin with three Shakti.

report.method: Dronacharya vs Dronacharya; paired seed bank seedBase + i * 0x9e3779b9; both geometries; 30–55% screening band. Small samples, not human balance validation. Candidates remain drafts.
